subject: Quick follow — re: meeting at RetailTech Summit + next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimble-retail.com>, Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow — re: meeting at RetailTech Summit + next steps

Hi Sophie / Diego — great to meet you at RetailTech Summit last week. Thanks again for stopping by the Redwood demo booth and for the discussion on inference latency for your in-store recommendation engine. I promised a short recap and suggested next steps so your team can decide whether a pilot makes sense.

Recap (from our chat):
- Current workload: online recommendations + cart ranking, avg prompt length ~120 tokens, peak QPS ~45.
- Pain: tail latency spikes during promotions and limited cost visibility for embeddings + cross-shop reranks.
- Goals: predictable p95 <= 120ms, 40% cost reduction vs current single-GPU baseline, and ability to run privately on GCP in your VPC.

Suggested next steps:
1) Technical sync (30–45m) with your infra + ML infra folks to validate traffic profile and PVC/VPC constraints.
2) Pilot proposal: 6-week pilot (dedicated pool) + a small benchmark eval using your sample prompts.
3) Legal/procurement intro and rough pricing ballpark (I can provide a standard MPA + SOW).

I've attached the demo deck and a one-page mutual action plan to speed approvals. If it helps, here are two slots I have this week: https://cal.me/jordan_blake/15.

Appreciate a quick note on priority — is this something you want to move onto the roadmap for Q2? If timelines shifted after the show, no worries — just tell me where it sits.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)]
[attachment: nimble-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimble-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow — re: meeting at RetailTech Summit + next steps

Thanks Jordan — great to meet you as well. Diego and I reviewed the materials briefly. High level: this aligns with a couple of initiatives we have, but FYI procurement is stretched this quarter and we may not be able to onboard a vendor until April/May.

We do want to understand the hard numbers on latency and cost with our prompts — can Ben (or an SE) run a short benchmark against a sample of our prompt set? If so, send me any NDA or testing instructions and Diego will coordinate.

Sophie
Head of ML Platform
Nimble Retail

Hi Sophie — following up on my note and Ben's offer to run the short benchmark. Wanted to check whether you had a window to share the sample prompts and any target success criteria.

We can:
- Run a 48–72 hour benchmark on a Redwood hosted eval using your anonymized prompts and provide p50/p95 latency, token cost, and an embedding similarity check.
- Or, if you prefer, provide a lightweight runner and instructions to execute in your environment (we can provide a config).

Ben is copied and can coordinate the technical details. If procurement timing is the blocker, we can do a non-prod eval first (no contract) so you have data for the SOW.

If you prefer a quick sync, here are two 15m slots tomorrow: https://cal.me/jordan_blake/15. Otherwise a short reply with "yes, send NDA" or "send eval instructions" is perfect.

Thanks — want to avoid this getting lost after a busy post-conference week.

Jordan
